title: Shinseiki Evangelion

alternative_titles.ja: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン

synopsis:
Fifteen years after a cataclysmic event known as the Second Impact, the world faces a new threat: monstrous celestial beings called Angels invade Tokyo-3 one by one. Mankind is unable to defend themselves against the Angels despite utilizing their most advanced munitions and military tactics. The only hope for human salvation rests in the hands of NERV, a mysterious organization led by the cold Gendou Ikari. NERV operates giant humanoid robots dubbed "Evangelions" to combat the Angels with state-of-the-art advanced weaponry and protective barriers known as Absolute Terror Fields.

Years after being abandoned by his father, Shinji Ikari, Gendou's 14-year-old son, returns to Tokyo-3. Shinji undergoes a perpetual internal battle against the deeply buried trauma caused by the loss of his mother and the emotional neglect he suffered at the hands of his father. Terrified to open himself up to another, Shinji's life is forever changed upon meeting 29-year-old Misato Katsuragi, a high-ranking NERV officer who shows him a free-spirited maternal kindness he has never experienced.

A devastating Angel attack forces Shinji into action as Gendou reveals his true motive for inviting his son back to Tokyo-3: Shinji is the only child capable of efficiently piloting Evangelion Unit-01, a new robot that synchronizes with his biometrics. Despite the brutal psychological trauma brought about by piloting an Evangelion, Shinji defends Tokyo-3 against the angelic threat, oblivious to his father's dark machinations.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Angel Attack!
episodes_data.description: In the year 2015, an Angel returns to attack Tokyo-3. Misato Katsuragi transports Shinji to the NERV base overseen by his estranged father, Gendo.

episodes_data.title: The Beast
episodes_data.description: After piloting the Eva Until 01, Shinji wakes up in the hospital with no memory of the battle. Feeling sorry for him, Misato lets him move in with her.

episodes_data.title: A Transfer
episodes_data.description: Word gets around school that Shinji is the Eva pilot; his classmate Toji resents him for it. An Angel appears and Shinji must pilot in combat again.

episodes_data.title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
episodes_data.description: Stressed out following his last battle. Shinji runs away from home and meets Kunsuke. After NERV brings him back in, Misato offers him a choice.

episodes_data.title: Rei I
episodes_data.description: Unit 00`s pilot Rei Ayanami appears to have recovered, but she has no friends, no records of her past, and no interest in getting to know Shinji.

episodes_data.title: Rei II
episodes_data.description: As the Fifth Angel drills toward NERV, Misato leads Operation Yashima: All of Japan`s power will be diverted to take out Ramiel with a positron rifle.

episodes_data.title: A Human Work
episodes_data.description: Ritsuko tells Shinji about the classified tru cause of the Second Impact. Then she and Misato attend the field test for an Eva competitor mecha.

episodes_data.title: Asuka Strikes!
episodes_data.description: Shinji and his friends accompany Misato to meet Eva Unit 02 and its pilot Asuka at sea. Misato`s old friend Ryoji Kaji is aboard with his own agenda.

episodes_data.title: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
episodes_data.description: Asuka and Shinji face another Angel but it gets the upper hand. They now have six days to learn synchronized moves to destroy it completely.

episodes_data.title: Magmadiver
episodes_data.description: NERV learns of an Angel in dormant embryonic form inside a volacno. Using equipment designed for magma, Asuka is sent to retrieve it with Unit 02.

episodes_data.title: The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still
episodes_data.description: Tokyo-3 loses power just as another Angel is detected. The Eva pilots must enter the base from the surface while NERV preps the Units manually.

episodes_data.title: She Said: "Don't Make Others Suffer for Your Personal Hatred."
episodes_data.description: With Gendo and Tuyutsuki in Antarctica, a newly promoted Misato is in charge when a new Angel appears above the Earth, aiming to bomb Tokyo-3.

episodes_data.title: Lilliputian Hitcher
episodes_data.description: An Angel infiltrates NERV, quickly taking over the MAGI supercomputer. Ritsuko proposes writing a program to forcibly evolve Ireri to its extinction.

episodes_data.title: Weaving A Story
episodes_data.description: As Seele reviews NERV and Gendo`s action with the Third through Eleventh Angels, Ritsuko conducts a test in which the Eva pilots switch Units.

episodes_data.title: Those Women Longed for the Touch of Others' Lips, and Thus Invited Their Kisses.
episodes_data.description: For the first time in years, Shinji meets his father at his mother`s grave. Ritsuko, Misato and Ryoji attend a wedding and Asuka goes on a date.

episodes_data.title: Splitting of the Breast
episodes_data.description: While in battle, Shinji and Unit 01 are engulfed in the spreading shadow of an Angel. As NERV fears them both lost, Shinji has a strange experience.

episodes_data.title: Fourth Children
episodes_data.description: NERV-02 in Nevada vanishes, along with the Eva Unit 04. With Unit 03 on the way, Gendo orders Ritsuko to assign a pilot to it.

episodes_data.title: Ambivalence
episodes_data.description: Unit 03 arrives from the United States, but Shinji still doesn`t know who its pilot is. During testing, NERV learns Unit 03 is possessed by an Angel.

episodes_data.title: Introjection
episodes_data.description: Distraught after the battle, Shinji vows to never pilot an Eva again and quits NERV once more. Just as he`s about to leave, another Angel attacks.

episodes_data.title: Weaving a Story 2: Oral Stage
episodes_data.description: After achieving an unheard of synchronization rate. Shinji merges with Unit 01. While he has an out of body experience, NERV works to salvage him.

episodes_data.title: He Was Aware that He Was Still a Child.
episodes_data.description: Seele kidnaps Fuyutsuki and interrogates him about NERV and Gendo`s true intentions, revealing events from the past. Ryoji goes missing.

episodes_data.title: Don't Be.
episodes_data.description: Asuka`s synchronization ratio continues to drop, undermining her self-confidence. Determined to show her worth, she ignores orders during battle.

episodes_data.title: Rei III
episodes_data.description: Despite her struggles, Asuka is ordered to assist Rei in battle against Armisael. When she fails, Rei makes a desperate move in order to save Shinji.

episodes_data.title: The Beginning and the End, or "Knockin' on the Heaven's Door"
episodes_data.description: Kaworu Nagisa, the Fifth Child, comes to NERV to pilot Unit 02 in Asuka`s place. He`s friendly to Shinji, but he`s shrouded in mystery.

episodes_data.title: Do You Love Me?
episodes_data.description: The Human Instrumentality Project begins, and the souls of humanity merge. The Eva pilots confront the nature of their existence as reality dissolves.

episodes_data.title: Take Care of Yourself.
episodes_data.description: The Human Instrumentality Project continues. Shinji must decide whether to accept a world alone, or embrace connections with others.
